## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing hero, Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** All pass against the policy allowlist.
  | Claim | Status |
  |---|---|
  | "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website" | On policy list. It matches the wording and says where the reviews are from. |
  | "Organic" | On policy list (certified organic by the Soil Association). |
  | "plastic-free bags" | On policy list (plastic-free, home compostable). |
  | "packed by hand in Bristol" | On policy list (every tin is packed by hand in Bristol). |
- **Regulated claims:** "Plastic-free" and "organic" are environmental-type claims, but both are specific and covered by the policy (certification, product fact). No broad "eco" or "sustainable" wording. Pass.
- **House style:** No banned words or AI tells. It is short, concrete and plain. Pass.
- **Disclosure:** The copy has no ad, sponsorship, affiliate, gifted-product or AI-content elements, so no label is needed. Pass.

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:** One small thing to confirm. The policy says every *tin* is packed by hand. The draft's "packed by hand in Bristol" could also be read as covering the tea bags. If the bags aren't hand-packed too, tighten it to "loose leaf tins packed by hand in Bristol". The same applies to "organic": confirm the Soil Association certification covers the bag range as well as the loose leaf. If both hold, publish as is.

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so the user needs to give an explicit yes to this exact text. I haven't recorded any approval, and nothing should publish until you give it.
